# Sherpa directory regression audit

Protected boundary: documented runtime/model directory flags/environment -> actual bundled wrapper -> native executable argv. The existing suite adds two POSIX-only source rows with a shell recorder, retaining model auto-discovery, valid output path and intentional spoken-text trimming. The recorder is only unit regression; real official engine WAV proof is distinct. No new product test seam or helper export. Original usage regression remains cross-platform.

Current-main full-native proof isolated runtime and model directory failures. Initial wider 13-cell candidate successfully fixed both directories but revealed native Sherpa itself trims explicit model/token/data argv. Those three production edits were reverted before publication. The final claim and seven-cell frozen native collector cover only wrapper-owned directory handling (four path probes + three controls), preserving the downstream-native selector behavior; failure evidence is retained. The change neither promises nor introduces support for trailing whitespace in native filename selectors. No cloud/provider/audio quality claim.
